mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, increasing corporate earnings and investor confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A weak labor market (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) combined with restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals economic distress and reduced corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate a slowdown.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank hawkishness and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL growth rate fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with weak industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST < 1300 AND INDPRO < 100) fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a rebound in retail sales (RSAFS) above 730,000 million dollars signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS rebound fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of post-recession recovery periods over a 3-year rolling window.
